contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is a genuinely EMPTY schedule: the ruled grid carries no ink at all - every faint mark on it is bleed-through from the reverse of the sheet, which resolves at 200 dpi as mirrored text. Cover line 1 reads zero in all three columns, so an empty schedule is the correct and consistent state. Every zero on this cover is written as a slashed-O nil glyph, which is 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling (core §3(f)); the Carr form prints no schedule total, so the cover is the only anchor. LAST = THIS = CUM = 0, so the scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: One hand-written row, 112.75, equals cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column (LAST is a slashed-O zero), so the scopes coincide and the single row is the whole cycle to date. The Carr form prints no schedule total.

gates.page_subtotal: no printed schedule total on either Carr schedule. p2: zero rows vs cover line1 = 0 in all three columns -> closes. p3: single row 112.75 = cover line3 THIS ($112.75) = CUM (112.75) -> closes.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py on p3 reports geometry_status ok, 36 rules / 35 bands / 34 data bands at a 2.327% pitch. The single inked row sits ABOVE the first data rule, in the leading band (8.98-11.82%) that the tool trims as a header - the classic write-above-the-rule case named in core §3(b), confirmed by my geometry crop at y=9.91% rendering the row's own '$112.75'. All 34 data bands are empty. 1 row emitted. p2 (Form A) has the same grid and no ink in any band.
gates.geometry_proof: p3: the single row's amount-cell crop renders '$112.75'; the control one row-pitch below renders EMPTY (only the ruled line). Only one row exists, so first and last row are the same crop.
gates.balance_chain: contributions 0 - expenses 112.75 = -112.75, but cover line 4 (Balance at the end of this reporting period) reads a POSITIVE 112.75 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. The chain does NOT close, and the residual is exactly the expenditure figure: the filer appears to have copied line 3 down into line 4 without signing it negative. FILER arithmetic, not a transcription defect - both printed figures are retained verbatim in the anchors and no figure was recomputed. No other filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was available.

escalation_note: p1 cover lines 1, 2, 3 and 4 each re-rendered as 1200 dpi three-cell band crops to confirm the nil glyphs are slashed-O zeros rather than a stray mark, and to read the blue-ink 112.75 figures; p3 date cell re-rendered at 1200 and then 2400 dpi with -normalize.

expenditures.note: DATE LEFT BLANK ON PURPOSE: the cell reads '3.1?.20' preceded by a small struck mark; the month (3) and the two-digit year (20) are unambiguous, but the day is two superimposed glyphs (a 9-shaped loop written over what looks like a 4), still unresolved at a 2400 dpi normalized crop, and no arithmetic anchor can settle a date. Verbatim kept here rather than guessed. Amount written '$112.75'; it is the only ink on the schedule and equals cover line 3.
